segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Create an utterance. let utterance = AVSpeechUtterance(string: "The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy dog.") // Configure the utterance. utterance.rate = 0.57 utterance.pitchMultiplier = 0.8 utterance.postUtteranceDelay = 0.2 utterance.volume = 0.8 // Retrieve the British English voice. let voice = AVSpeechSynthesisVoice(language: "en-GB") // Assign the voice to the utterance. utterance.voice = voice ```
